article.paragraph 1: 33-year-old man shot by police identified by friends, officer stabbed recovering
article.paragraph 2: Friends tell CTV News 33-year-old Evan Caron is the man fatally shot by police in The Maples Saturday afternoon.
article.paragraph 3: Winnipeg police said it happened after Caron stabbed a police officer, in the 100 block of Madrigal Close.
article.paragraph 4: Several family members declined to interview with CTV, but a woman close with Caron said the people in his life have questions and strong feelings about what happened.
article.paragraph 5: Court documents obtained by CTV News show Caron had 13 prior convictions, including three assaults, and spent time in and out of police custody and under supervised probation.
article.paragraph 6: This spring Caron was charged with assault and ordered to stay away from the victim. Neighbours said they have seen Caron taken away by police twice in the past.
article.paragraph 7: Police officer stabbed with a knife: police union
article.paragraph 8: Meanwhile, the Winnipeg Police Association said Monday the 35-year-old officer who was stabbed is out of hospital and recuperating.
article.paragraph 9: George Van Mackelbergh, vice-president of the police association, said he knows the seasoned officer who has been with the tactical support team for several years.
article.paragraph 10: Van Mackelbergh said he was stabbed with a knife, with a quite a bit of force.
article.paragraph 11: "Received an injury from a stab to his arm. Had to have surgery to remove the broken tip of the knife from his arm,” he said.
article.paragraph 12: Van Mackelbergh said officers are well trained and have good equipment, but there are often close calls.
article.paragraph 13: He said the association wants to thank everyone who has expressed support.
article.paragraph 14: On Sunday police chief Danny Smyth spoke at a police memorial and expressed gratitude for officers who face risks on the job.
article.paragraph 15: Independent Investigation Unit of Manitoba now involved
article.paragraph 16: The investigation has been handed over to Manitoba's Independent Investigation Unit, which investigates all serious incidents involving police officers.
article.paragraph 17: The IIU said police originally responded to a 911 call Saturday regarding a domestic dispute.
article.paragraph 18: It is now looking for witnesses or people who may information or video footage to share with investigators.
